verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes documentation explicitly covers running arbitrary shell commands (sb.exec, CLI 'run a command or interactive shell inside a Modal container'), custom images with any dependency installation, filesystem access, and community reports (HN self-hosted runners, JS agent runtime) corroborate real-world use for arbitrary command execution and untrusted code. Missing for 10: no independent benchmark of package installation limits or explicit documented apt/pip install examples beyond generic 'any dependency' claim.
